title: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Learn the power of Object-Oriented Programming to build sophisticated, modular applications in Python.

sections.content: OOP stands for Object-Oriented Programming. It lets you create your own data types using classes.

exercises.question: Create a class called `Cat` with an `__init__` method that takes a `name`. Create an instance called `my_cat` with the name "Whiskers" and print the name.
